responsibility: This implementation module maps the Builtins interface onto GCC-recognized builtin entry points and fallback C wrappers from cbuiltin and wrapc. It is part of the low-level gm2 compiler/runtime boundary: procedures are annotated so the compiler can replace calls with builtins when possible, while the module also supplies callable fallback implementations for procedure-variable use, special no-op stubs for internally replaced operations like setjmp/longjmp and frame/return address queries, and tracing support for stack allocation debugging.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the Builtins pair: unlike Builtins.def, which only lists intrinsic signatures, this file attaches GCC builtin attributes and provides executable wrappers, fallbacks, and stub bodies for operations such as memcpy, math intrinsics, setjmp/longjmp, and frame/return address queries.
